description: Land Title Settlement Department - Notice calling for claims to property of Intestate in Moratuwa D/S Division, Colombo District  - Cad. Map No. 520202 and other properties
categorisation: This gazette content deals specifically with land and property matters - it contains notices calling for claims to intestate property (property of deceased persons without wills) under the Registration of Title Act. The content includes detailed land descriptions, parcel numbers, extents of land, and procedures for property registration, which falls squarely within the Land Gazette classification (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
